manifest.name: ring-10
manifest.codec: global varint skip/length with raw literal characters
manifest.presentationTiming: At least two PAL fields. Copy and delta run after the first complete field; flip only at the next line-256 boundary. Extra fields are allowed if work overruns.

checkpoints.presented: Just after D018 changes; scanout still belongs to the old field.
checkpoints.frame_done: First complete visible field of frame_index; frame_counter has incremented.
checkpoints.copy_start: Old frame_index/front selected, next_frame is target; copy into next ring slot.
checkpoints.copy_end: All 1024 bytes copied, before any delta stores.
checkpoints.render_start: Before patch-pointer load and exact delta decode into back buffer.
checkpoints.render_end: Target screen complete; old frame_index/front still selected.
checkpoints.held_frame_done: After next boundary, immediately before flip; old screen and pose still selected.

manifest.abi: Repeat skip LEB128, literalLength LEB128, literal bytes until screen position 1000. Before every patch, copy all 1024 bytes from displayed front to the next ring screen.
manifest.memoryAccounting: Ten 1024-byte working screens are runtime RAM, not movie payload. No stored seed screen. Meaningful loaded bytes excludes PRG address-gap padding, working screens, color RAM and zero page. Code state includes ring tables; pointers and playback bytecode are counted separately.

method: Owned, unmodified native PAL VICE; forced refresh disabled. Actual completed VIC scanouts, hardware bank/slot, full 1024-byte copies, hidden writes, all ring buffers, source immutability and script counters are checked. Memory write checkpoints guard front/font/movie during native execution.
scope: Complete native10-buffer player with no music/interrupt workload. Every completed visible field in the bounded loop sample was independently compared; no skipped intermediate fields are accepted.
